description: Advisero Advisero automates repetitive customer service cases by naturally answering even complex questions. While being passionate about BOT powered improvements and solutions, it doesn't want to build yet another simple tree chatbot designer. Instead, it focuses on one specific use case with real financial value where the customers can save literally millions in the first year of implementation.

Apropo Apropo is a SaaS platform that helps tech companies to win more projects thanks to automating the project cost estimating process. It's the world's first platform that does it with a track record of reducing the project estimation time even 4 times. Apropo's vision is to become a Jira for project estimates, so a tool that sets the standards worldwide.

Bin-e Bin-e is the world's most advanced system which uses AI and other modern technologies to simplify recycling and facilitate the transition to a circular economy. It automatically recognises and segregates waste, including such items as electronics or batteries. Thorough data on waste production is provided via the app, enabling the creation of detailed CSR reports.

Biocam BioCam designs and manufactures an endoscopic capsule for imaging of the digestive system along with AI-powered software for automatic detection and real-time determination of potential threats. The company's goal is to reduce the cost of gastrointestinal examinations, increase patient comfort and popularization of capsule endoscopy.

Bisonte Bisonte designs, develops and implements advanced mechatronic devices capable of operating in harsh environments. The company was founded with the goal to provide the world with revolutionary robotic solution - an underwater drone with the variable-geometry hull.

Frontu Frontu is a field service management software provider focusing on frontline field service workers. The company delivers a digital solution for field service companies that enables them to save time and resources, optimize business processes, and improve employee well-being.

Husarnet Husarnet is a peer-to-peer VPN network dedicated for robots, autonomous vehicles and industry 4.0 applications. It provides direct, private, fast, and extremely secure data link between connected devices such as: robots, servers, laptops, cell phones, microcontrollers and more. Founders - Dominik Nowak, Filip Kramarczyk.

Hydropolis Hydropolis provides controlled cultivation technology. The key element is algorithms that optimize plant growth conditions, accelerating plant growth. Hydroponic, vertical and isolated cultivation intensifies the yield from the surface. With these solutions, production takes place 365 days a year, regardless of climate and anywhere - shortening the supply chain and reducing costs.

Labplus Labplus develops technology using AI to improve medical diagnosis. The system uses a knowledge base, created by doctors with the support of medical schools and constantly expanded with the latest guidelines and scientific sources, to present possible diagnoses.

Miesna Paczka Fresh meat directly from producers to customers' doors - without additives, antibiotics, hormones or GMOs. So simple and yet - so hard. Meat frozen in the highest freshness point delivered in D2C model. Investment made with, among others - Żabka Polska [biggest chain of convenience stores in Poland].

Nethansa Nethansa is the leading provider of AI-driven marketplace automation solutions and services. Their authorial software platform Clipperon increases the efficiency of Amazon shops. Clipperon is dedicated to retailers who want to run more efficient e-commerce. Nethansa is a certified service and technology provider approved by Amazon Service Provider Network and Amazon Marketplace Appstore.

ProperGate ProperGate is a smart delivery management system providing real-time information and control of materials on complex construction sites. The startup helps construction companies digitalise their onsite logistics. In 2022 considered as construction tech startup of the year by Urban Tech Challengers.

QTIC.AI QTIC.AI is first global digital Testing, Inspections and Certification company. Company deliver faster and cheaper, than traditional TIC companies, all kinds of inspection’s services for all industries. QTIC.AI worldwide network of inspection professionals is qualified with wide range of respected diplomas, certficates and codes that cover all industrial categories.

Quantum Blockchains is a startup aiming to create functioning Blockchain technology capable of resisting the currently emerging threats from Quantum Computers. The company is making a radical step, and instead of post-quantum algorithms, it uses the latest achievements of quantum cryptography to create provably secure solutions, which enhance data protection, integrity and processing speed.

description: Smart Hotel The SmartHotel system is a link between guests, hotel employees, and apartment owners. It does not require installing any additional applications - instead, it uses the most popular communication channels, such as WhatsApp and Messenger, to improve hotel service, enhance the guest experience and increase the owners' profits.

Talkie Talkie is an AI-powered virtual agent, which uses natural language to provide phone customer service 24/7. It automates repetitive processes in call centers and significantly reduces costs. Talkie is also great at managing high volume campaigns where thousands of customers have to be reached in a short space of time.

Teamsharq A platform based on remote workspaces available in a web browser for instructor-led, real-time online courses, tech recruitment and teamwork. Teamsharq comprehensively supports the entire remote process. From a management system to the powerful computer hardware available directly in a web browser. For your employees, clients and teammates. Anywhere, anytime, instantly.

Upmedic The upmedic system is intelligent software for creating high-quality structured documentation accessible from a web browser. Company focus on meeting the ever-increasing demand for medical diagnostics by helping physicians make accurate patient treatment decisions faster.

Virbe Virbe is a Virtual Being creation suite licensed as technology-as-a-service, which transforms ConversationalAI and chatbots into interactive human-like avatars with natural voice and conversation capabilities. Virtual beings can work 24/7 on any kind of website, mobile app, or physical location (eg. kiosks) and are perfect for an autonomous customer experience.

Znika ZNIKA is an environmental startup, which is dedicated to fighting plastic pollution. A team of sustainable development specialists, activists and engineers came together to create fully compostable packaging solutions for business. Thanks to their R&D process, they will have their own formula for compostable bioplastic, which will revolutionize the packaging sector.
